## 2. i18n

**Library: none — hand-rolled.** `src\lib\i18n.tsx` (242 lines).

- `:215` `export type Key = [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] typeof messages.en` — the en catalog is the key type source of truth
- `:221-224` `catalogs`, `supportedLocales = ["en","zh-CN"]`, `translationKeys()`, `translation(locale,key)`
- `:228-236` `I18nProvider`; locale persisted at `localStorage["ji.preferences.v1.locale"]` (`:229-230`); `t(key, values)` does simple `{name}` replacement (`:232`)

**Key organization:** flat camelCase namespace-by-prefix, roughly grouped by feature in comment-free runs: nav/shell → composer/queue → run status → reasoning/permission modes → search → resources/extensions → settings/provider-profiles/credentials → relay enrollment + connection string → conversation/transcript/tool output → session tree/branch → search/queue micro-copy. 2. `src\lib\i18n.test.tsx` — `:18-33` direct `catalogs` comparison + an explicit allowlist of credential/relay keys that must exist in both; `:10-16` asserts locale switching + localStorage persistence.
3. Type-level: `zh-CN` is typed `Record<Key,string>` via `catalogs` (`i18n.tsx:221`), so a missing zh key is a compile error during `pnpm build`.

Convention when adding copy: add the key to **both** `en` and `zh-CN` blocks in `src\lib\i18n.tsx`; the tests fail otherwise.

## 8. Theme tokens, dark mode, layout patterns to reuse

`src\styles.css` (313 lines) — Tailwind v4 via `@import "tailwindcss"` (`:1`) plus one `@source` line (`:2`). **No `@theme` block and no shadcn CSS-variable token set** — the actual styling is hand-written CSS below the import, with a `--ji-*` custom-property convention.

**Tokens**

The dark-theme contract is enforced by tests, not by tooling: `src\styles.contrast.test.ts:5-6` splits the stylesheet on the literal string `"@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)"` and `:22-26` reads token values out of it by regex — so **moving or renaming the dark block breaks the test**. **Layout patterns to reuse for an orchestration panel**
- Shell: `.app-shell` grid `15rem minmax(0,1fr)` (`:21`), `.sidebar` dark `#0d1729` (`:22`), `.workspace` (`:31`); collapses to `.mobile-bar` under `max-width: 720px` (`:248-251`).

- Section: `.settings-section { max-width: 48rem }` (`:221`); `.relay-management` is the **closest existing model for a new panel** — `display:grid; gap:1rem` with grid labels/inputs and a `.resource-list` device table (`:222-226`).
- Tabs: the `ResourcesPage` pattern at `App.tsx:512` is the one to copy — `<Tabs value={tab}><TabsList>{values.map(v => <TabsTrigger asChild><Link to={...}>{labels[v]}</Link></TabsTrigger>)}</TabsList>{values.map(v => <TabsContent>...)}</Tabs>` — i.e. **tab state lives in the URL (`:tab` route param), not in React state**. CSS: `[role="tablist"]` / `[role="tab"][data-state="active"]` at `:204-206`.
- Panels/cards: `.trust-panel` (`:211-214`, grid + `<code>` block + flex `.dialog-actions` row) and `.resource-list article` (`:207-210`, two-column list rows) — these are the reusable "status block" and "list row" patterns.
- Form grids: `.profile-editor` 2-column grid with `grid-column: 1/-1` full-width children for headers/errors/fieldsets (`:228-240`) — a good template for a multi-field orchestration form; `ExtensionManager`'s `grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(14rem,1fr) auto; align-items:end` (`:216`) is the compact inline-form variant.
- Action rows: `.dialog-actions`, `.credential-actions`, `.profile-actions` — all `display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap`.
- Responsive: single `@media (max-width: 720px)` block at `:248-276`; the profile form collapses to one column at `:270-272`.

**Rules that constrain a new panel** — `docs\rules\frontend-performance.md` §§1-5 (state at the minimal consuming boundary; split Context by domain and by update frequency; no `JSON.stringify(wholeObject)` memo keys; keyboard input must not re-render history/markdown), plus `docs\rules\ui-interaction.md` and `docs\rules\data-loading.md`. - i18n keys go into **both** blocks of `src\lib\i18n.tsx` or `i18n-catalog.test.ts` fails.
- Add styles to `src\styles.css` **and** a dark-mode counterpart inside the `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` block at `:277`, or `styles.contrast.test.ts` and the axe e2e scan can fail.
- Use `useHostClient()` (`src\lib\host-client.tsx:135`) so the panel works over both REST and Relay; surface structured `ProblemDetails.code` values as `data-error-code` on the `role="alert"` element and map them to i18n keys, matching `credential-secret-field.tsx:7-11,82`.
- e2e specs mock `**/api/v1/**` with `page.route` and run `AxeBuilder`; a new spec under `e2e/` automatically runs in all three viewport projects.
